input.free_text_description: This system is an user management platform that serves User, Customer roles. The platform provides capabilities for account command handler, i account command handler, i transaction command handler. Secondary concerns include distributed transactions functionality.

user_stories.story: As a User, I want to search and filter records, so that I can quickly find relevant information.
As a User, I want to interact with account functionality, so that I can accomplish my account-related tasks.
As a User, I want to interact with account transaction functionality, so that I can accomplish my account transaction-related tasks.
As a User, I want to interact with customer functionality, so that I can accomplish my customer-related tasks.
As a User, I want to use account command handler capabilities, so that I can perform essential business operations.
